<description>
Add script_tests.json and tx_invalid.json vectors for edge cases that
other implementations have gotten wrong, including CSV with -2, IFDUP
on negative zero, ROLL with duplicate values, a taproot output key
that is not a valid x coordinate, and single-flag STRICTENC, LOW_S and
NULLFAIL cases.

Some policy cases were only caught by the tx_valid harness adding
flags back, which implementations copying the JSON don't replicate.

Related: #36455

These were discovered by finding gaps in an alternate implementation (bitcoin-s)
</description>
